Title: Relates to humanoid robots and artificial intelligence avatars in instructional settings
Summary: Provides that each school district, charter school, and board of cooperative educational services shall adopt and implement a written policy governing the use of humanoid robots in schools and that such policy shall prohibit the use of an artificial intelligence-enabled humanoid robot in an instructional capacity; defines terms.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the education law, in relation to humanoid robots and artificial intelligence avatars in instructional settings
